# Examples sidebar hover makes group labels unreadable

## Context

The operator reported that hovering Trees in the Examples sidebar on `/apps/portal/#/examples` makes its label disappear in Neo Dark. The same browser probe reproduces the defect in Neo Light.

## The Problem

At 1440 × 900 on `dev` `6952886dce`, pointer hover makes the Trees label and its background identical. Neo Dark resolves both to `rgb(240, 241, 244)`. Neo Light resolves both to `rgb(14, 15, 13)`. Label contrast is 1:1 in both. The count also loses contrast.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/GroupIndex.css` inherits the Examples foreground and paints inactive hover with `--portal-examples-entry-hover`. The shared GroupIndex renders the desktop list, mobile overview and mobile sheet.
- The two `resources/css/theme-neo-{dark,light}/apps/portal/examples/MainContainer.css` files bind that local token to `--sem-color-bg-neutral-hover`, which intentionally has the same value as `--sem-color-text-neutral-default` in these themes. The existing list-item and tab hover mappings use `--sem-color-surface-neutral-hover`, a translucent overlay over their neutral surface.
- Design authority is the group navigation under #21140 and the shipped GroupIndex states from #21325.

## The Fix

Bind the local Examples hover token to the existing semantic surface-hover token in Neo Dark and Neo Light. Add a browser regression to the existing `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` using the rendered navigation row.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Hovering an inactive Examples link gives visible feedback in Neo Dark and Neo Light. Its label and count have at least 4.5:1 contrast against the painted row.
- [ ] The current-page indicator remains visible on hover and the keyboard focus outline remains visible in both themes.
- [ ] The E2E proof reproduces the bad contrast at the base and passes with the corrected theme mapping.

## Out of Scope

Example-card interaction styles and navigation structure.

## Avoided Traps

Keep the shared semantic tokens intact. The local alias can reuse the existing surface hover treatment without changing other consumers.

Related: #21140, #21325, #21676
